backend/main.mo: Minimal Internet Computer actor exposing a confirmDesignPreview method that returns a static confirmation message indicating no backend changes are required.
feature_evidence.json: Structured feature evidence report documenting completed frontend features, associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for Banarasi catalog expansion and UI enhancements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Precompiled index of frontend source files with concise human-written descriptions of each component’s purpose and recent enhancements.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind and CSS variable definitions establishing light/dark themes, luxury color tokens, base styles, and design system foundations.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document configuring metadata, favicon and branding assets, Google Fonts loading, dark theme default, and mounting the React app.
frontend/RELEASE_NOTES.md: Draft Version 5 release notes detailing the full luxury cinematic theme refresh, visual system, site architecture, UX improvements, and preserved animations.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application shell wiring theme management, commerce state, background animations, global layout sections, header/footer, chat widget, and backend actor initialization.
frontend/src/assets/branding.ts: Centralized constants exporting brand name and static asset paths for logo, favicon, and bot avatar.
frontend/src/commerce/CommerceProvider.t: React context provider managing cart state with localStorage persistence, cart mutations, derived totals, and item counts using dummy product data.
frontend/src/components/banarasi/Banaras: Displays a dialog overlay with a carousel of Banarasi products for a selected category, including navigation controls. Integrates ProductCard, quick view sheet, detail view, and dynamic metadata updates.
Renders the main Banarasi collections showcase page with ambience effects, grouped category sections, and dynamic metadata. Manages quick view and product detail modals across all categories.
Represents a single Banarasi category section with header, description, and a carousel of product cards. Adds scroll-reveal animations, optional autoplay, and respects reduced-motion settings.

Renders a slide-up overlay showing quick details for a Banarasi product, including colors, fabric, pattern, price, rating, and actions like share or add to cart. It conditionally displays based on product ID, category, and visibility, using dummy product data.

Draws a full-screen animated canvas with pearl-like shimmer particles for ambient background effects, respecting reduced motion preferences. Falls back to a static gradient overlay when motion is reduced.
Provides a skeleton loading placeholder for Banarasi product cards, mimicking image, text, price, and action layouts while data is loading.
frontend/src/components/cart/CartPanel.t: Displays cart contents with product details, quantity controls, removal actions, and subtotal using commerce hooks and dummy product data. Shows an empty-state message when the cart has no items.
frontend/src/components/cart/CartSheet.t: Wraps the CartPanel inside a right-side sheet modal with a header, handling open/close state and checkout triggering.
frontend/src/components/checkout/Checkou: Implements the checkout form for contact and shipping details and shows an order summary based on cart contents. Submits data via a checkout mutation and reports success with an order ID.
Controls the checkout flow inside a sheet modal, toggling between the checkout form and success screen based on order completion.
Shows an order confirmation screen with animation support, displaying the order ID and a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/components/CinematicHeroSli: Renders a single cinematic hero slide with layered parallax animations (particles, silhouettes, gold waves) and animated text, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
Manages a full-screen hero slider with autoplay, swipe/drag, navigation controls, and gold wave transitions between multiple CinematicHeroSlide instances.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with brand description, quick navigation links, and a copyright notice with external attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the sticky site header with branding, navigation links, cart and checkout controls, user authentication menu, and responsive mobile behavior.
frontend/src/components/hero/GoldWaveLay: Renders an animated canvas layer of flowing gold wave gradients for hero sections, adapting behavior for active slides and reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/hero/GoldWaveWip: Displays a gold gradient wipe overlay animation during transitions, with a simplified version when reduced motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/hero/PearlShimme: Canvas-based React component that renders animated pearl-like shimmer particles for the hero section, respecting reduced-motion preferences. Animation runs conditionally based on active slide state and resizes with the window.
frontend/src/components/hero/ProductSilh: Renders decorative, animated circular silhouette elements positioned across the hero background. Animations scale and fade based on active state and are disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
frontend/src/components/hero/ScrollHintA: Displays a scroll hint link with a downward chevron icon that anchors to the collections section. Includes optional bounce animation depending on reduced-motion preference.
frontend/src/components/LetterRevealText: Animates headline text by revealing letters sequentially when active, with an instant fallback for reduced-motion users.
Draws an animated ocean-themed canvas background using noise-based waves, foam particles, and sand texture, optimized with refs and reduced-motion handling.
frontend/src/components/product/ImageZoo: Interactive product image gallery with hover-based zoom, thumbnail selection, and next/previous navigation. Zoom and motion effects are disabled when reduced motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders an interactive product card with image, price, wishlist, and add-to-cart actions, including animations, ripples, and toasts. Handles quick view, detail navigation, and Banarasi-specific hover behavior using dummy product data.
frontend/src/components/QuickViewSheet.t: Implements a right-side sheet for quick product viewing with image, price, stock info, and add-to-cart functionality. Uses add-to-cart animations, ripple effects, and closes automatically on successful add.
frontend/src/components/raahi/raahiRespo: Defines a rule-based keyword-response engine for the RaaHi chatbot, mapping common user intents to predefined friendly replies. Operates entirely without external AI or LLM dependencies.
Provides a floating chatbot widget with a toggleable chat window, session-based greeting, message history, and simulated typing delays. Generates bot replies via a helper function and respects reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/SangamBackground: File is currently empty and does not export any component or logic.
frontend/src/data/banarasiCategories.ts: Exports a typed registry of curated Banarasi saree collection categories with metadata like descriptions, patterns, color families, occasions, and cover images.
frontend/src/data/banarasiGrouping.ts: Provides a deterministic client-side utility to group Banarasi products into predefined categories using heuristic checks on names, patterns, and color attributes.
frontend/src/data/dummyProducts.ts: Contains interfaces and helper logic for generating a large dummy product catalog, primarily focused on Banarasi sarees with rich metadata and image assets.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor using React Query, switching between anonymous and authenticated actors based on Internet Identity. Invalidates and refetches all non-actor queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddToCartAnimation: Provides an animate function that creates a fly-to-cart visual animation from a source element to the cart button. Respects prefers-reduced-motion and cleans up the temporary DOM element on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useCinematicSlider.ts: Manages state and controls for a slider with autoplay, pause/resume, and swipe/drag navigation. Exposes handlers for pointer events and slide navigation helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommerce.ts: Convenience hook to access the CommerceContext. Throws an error if used outside of the CommerceProvider.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicMetadata.ts: Dynamically updates document title and meta description when mounted and restores original values on cleanup. Useful for per-page SEO metadata changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoldRipple.ts: Creates a gold ripple click/touch effect on elements using the Web Animations API. Adjusts animation duration based on reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useInfiniteScroll.ts: Implements infinite scrolling using an IntersectionObserver on a sentinel element. Calls onLoadMore when the sentinel enters view and loading conditions allow.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, identity state, and status flags. Wraps AuthClient creation and persistence logic in a React provider.
React hook that syncs state with localStorage, including safe initialization and updates. Supports functional state updates and SSR-safe defaults.
frontend/src/hooks/useMousePosition.ts: Tracks the current mouse cursor position by listening to mousemove events. Returns x and y coordinates or null before movement.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects whether the user prefers reduced motion using a media query. Updates reactively when the preference changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for products, cart, orders, and checkout using a frontend-first mock implementation. Integrates with CommerceContext and useActor to manage state and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollReveal.ts: Provides React hooks to reveal elements when they enter the viewport using IntersectionObserver, with options for thresholds, margins, and staggered delays. Respects reduced-motion preferences by revealing immediately.
frontend/src/hooks/useWishlist.ts: Manages a wishlist stored in localStorage, exposing helpers to add, remove, toggle, clear items, and check if a product is wishlisted.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS setup with extensive CSS variables for light and dark luxury themes, typography, and base styles. Includes custom utility classes for layouts, gradients, masonry grids, and product card effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app, wiring up React Query and Internet Identity providers and importing global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the About section with animated scroll-reveal blocks describing brand values, philosophy, and heritage using icons and styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutSection.tsx: Displays a secure checkout marketing section highlighting payment security, privacy, and payment options with scroll-reveal animations and a call-to-action button.
frontend/src/pages/FaqSection.tsx: Implements a FAQ section using an accordion component, with scroll-reveal animations for the header and question list.
frontend/src/pages/HomeSection.tsx: Defines the home section container and renders a cinematic hero slider as the main above-the-fold content.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailView.tsx: Full-screen modal view for product details, showing images, pricing, stock, quantity selection, and add-to-cart behavior with metadata updates and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProductSection.tsx: Defines a marketing section highlighting four brand promises using icon cards and scroll-reveal animations via a reusable RevealBlock wrapper.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Implements the main products listing page with a Banarasi category showcase, masonry grid of other products, staggered scroll-reveal animations, quick view/detail modals, and infinite scroll loading from a dummy catalog.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Declares core frontend TypeScript interfaces for products, carts, orders, and an ExtendedProduct type with optional commerce and presentation metadata.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, luxury shadows, animations, and typography/animation plugins.
project_state.json: Stores high-level project metadata and feature inventory describing the React luxury storefront, its design theme, dummy commerce setup, and current backend/authentication capabilities.
